Callout.Name: Contraband Drop
Callout.Message: Suspected contraband drop at the perimeter.
Callout.Advisory: Vehicle seen slowing at the fence, package recovered.

Script.Line: It came over on the hour. Same spot as last week.
It was wrapped in tape and there was a phone inside it.
There is a vehicle comes past slowly most nights. That is all I have.

Lines.Approach: Something came over the fence and we have it. The vehicle that threw it did not stop.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
